label: Deck
quotes: The Deck module implements the Deck organism component that assembles and navigates between slides in a presentation, wiring up theme toggling and stop/mark navigation via useDeckNavigation.
A React hook that implements deck navigation, computing the active slide position and helper lookups like reduced, photoOf, box, and nameOf for a presentation deck.
